summary.text: Divination Tortoise Transformation is Fang Yuan's immortal killer move that turns him into a wisdom path divination tortoise. Its cores are change form Immortal Gu and divination tortoise shell Immortal Gu.

claims.text: After leaving an Eastern Sea trading convention under a sudden wisdom path deduction, Fang Yuan activates the new divination tortoise shell Immortal Gu with change form Immortal Gu as the immortal killer move Divination Tortoise Transformation. Without many mortal Gu the effect is weak, and the form lacks the divination tortoise’s battle strength, but change form still lets him take the shape and buy time.

After more than ten days of deduction he finishes a battle ready divination tortoise transformation. Its only two cores remain rank seven divination tortoise shell Immortal Gu and change form Immortal Gu. He adds many transformation path mortal Gu such as tortoise head, tortoise tail, and tortoise leg Gu, plus wisdom path Gu to raise deduction blocking, and many defensive Gu, until he reaches his then limit. The move combines transformation path and wisdom path, like ancient sword dragon transformation combining transformation path and sword path. Unlike ancient sword dragon transformation, reverse flow protection seal, and Myriad Self, which he could not use in battle then, this move covers that fighting gap.

Before Xia Fei Kuai finishes bellowing at him to fight, Fang Yuan’s body shines and he turns into the divination tortoise, a contrast to his long stalling that leaves Xia Fei Kuai stunned. Standing on four pillar-like legs, the huge dark-shelled body fills the whole valley, its shell covered in thousands to tens of thousands of eye-catching markings that leave Xia Zhuo Mo dizzy after staring too long. Skipping the usual probing exchange that opens a spar, Fang Yuan uses this immortal killer move immediately as his trump card, and Xia Zhuo Mo reads the tortoise’s hard shell as explaining why Fang Yuan picked this particular form of combat.

In a Southern Border spar, the completed form is a rank seven immortal killer move with those same two cores. Activating divination tortoise shell Immortal Gu alone already gives a shell not weaker than an ancient divination tortoise; with the supplementary Gu the shell’s defense exceeds a real ancient divination tortoise. Xia Fei Kuai’s soaring essence strike smashes the tortoise into the ground yet leaves the shell undented.
Against Black Tigress inside the super Gu formation, Fang Yuan turns into the divination tortoise and stops moving, using the transformed body to block the formation’s damaged hole.
He still lists divination tortoise transformation among his defensive methods, but treats the ancient desolate beast divination tortoise as useless in a rank eight battle.

Constituent Gu.text: Change Form Immortal Gu Divination Tortoise Shell Immortal Gu
